_meta.note: Competitor landscape for the BD white-label OTA market. Compiled from the GTM package's 02_COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS.md — 28 vendors profiled from ~38 sources. Every claim was read off the vendor's own published page unless the row says otherwise. Only two vendors publish a price.

groups.title: Bangladeshi direct competitors
groups.note: These are the ones you actually lose deals to.

vendors.name: Travonis Limited
strengths: 30+ payment gateways: bKash, Nagad, Rocket/DBBL, SSLCommerz, EBL, BRAC, City Bank, Stripe
Suppliers include BDFare, Duffel, Novoair, Verteil, Atlas, Sabre, Travelport, Amadeus, Agoda, Expedia, HotelBeds
Bangla + English support from a Bangladeshi team
weaknesses: Flights and hotels only — cars, tours and buses are listed as future support
Modules are rationed by tier; the caps are published on their own page
Footer reads "Powered by Innovate Solution" and "© Reservation Hub 2025" — it is a Bangladesh skin on Singapore/UAE ReservationHub, not local IP
Their coverage claims "launch in under 24 hours" and "under 8 working days" in the same article
vendors.attack: Agree on price, then ask which modules they must give up to hit it. Their own pricing page publishes the caps.

vendors.name: zooFamily / zooIT
vendors.pricing: One-time: Corporate $650 · NON-IATA $1,150 · IATA $2,500 · hosting $99/yr · Flight API $650 · Hotel API $650 · GDS API fee $250 · GDS security deposit $2,000 (one GDS) / $5,000 (three)
strengths: Dhanmondi and Uttara offices
Owns the IATA agencies Airways Office and Travelzoo Bangladesh Ltd
Runs travelnews.com.bd — owns the trade's attention
Meets prospects at their travel-business training course months before they are licensed
weaknesses: Tour and Visa modules are "upload active" with no live inventory
WhatsApp-only sales funnel
The same PCC is quoted as both ৳3,500 and ৳5,499 on one page
Markets an explicitly priced "GDS API HX remover" at $250 and "no ADM" positioning
vendors.attack: Compliance flank. For an IATA holder with real ADM and audit exposure, sell auditability, documented GDS relationships and one consistent contract. Do not fight at their price point.

vendors.name: M360 ICT Ltd.
vendors.pricing: Not published anywhere on m360ict.com, trabill.biz or any secondary source
vendors.address: House 74, Road 7, Block H, Banani, Dhaka · +8809638336699
strengths: Trabill — travel agency management and accounting SaaS, BASIS National ICT Award 2022 champion in Tourism & Hospitality
Commonwealth and South Asian Business Excellence awards; independently reported as used in 11–15 countries
Portfolio of 12+ products: AFOMS, Hotel360, Dokani POS, ERP BD, CRM360, Hajj Management, Islam360, TaskMate
Sister concerns: On The Way Ltd, T360, G360 Tours Australia, BookingExpert.us, AIBT
weaknesses: Trabill and the OTA at ota.m360ict.com are two separate products, not one platform
No published price anywhere
vendors.attack: Do not attack the brand — the awards are real. Attack the architecture: ask what happens when a booking has to reconcile against the accounting ledger across two systems. Then ask them for a written price.

vendors.name: IV Trip (Implevista)
vendors.pricing: Not published; their blog says "many agencies invest only a few lakhs BDT in setup"
strengths: Full Bangla–English toggle
bKash / Nagad / Rocket / SSLCommerz plus manual bank deposit
Multi-currency BDT / USD / AED / SAR
weaknesses: Positioned as agency management, not OTA distribution
vendors.attack: Lead with the B2B sub-agent panel and the rules engine — distribution, not bookkeeping.

groups.title: BD B2B portals and consolidators
groups.note: Same wallet, different product. They give the agent a free storefront and keep the brand.

vendors.name: BDFare
strengths: B2B portal + flight API + NDC + white-label; Banani, launched 2023
weaknesses: Appears as a supplier on Travonis's own pricing page
vendors.attack: Treat as a potential inventory partner and a competitor in the same conversation. Escalate the channel conflict before Wave 1.

vendors.name: ShareTrip B2B
strengths: Air, hotel, holidays, visa; agent mobile app
weaknesses: The agent books on ShareTrip's brand and inventory
No white-label licence product found
vendors.attack: The passenger sees ShareTrip, not the agency. That is the whole pitch.

vendors.name: Ticket Lagbe Ltd.
strengths: BD + UAE + Singapore, IATA code 42343755, iOS and Android agent apps

vendors.name: Buy Air Ticket Ltd.
strengths: B2B portal; resells Travelport / Sabre / Amadeus login IDs to BD agents
weaknesses: The Ordinance's credential-sharing ban puts that practice under pressure
vendors.attack: Every agent renting a shared GDS login is a prospect who needs a compliant answer.

vendors.name: GoZayaan · Flight Expert
strengths: Consumer OTAs with B2B portals for sub-agents
weaknesses: Not a licensable platform
vendors.attack: An agency will never out-advertise GoZayaan and should not try. It wins on relationship, service and its own sub-agent network — we make those three scalable.

groups.title: Indian and global vendors with Bangladesh landing pages
groups.note: Not one has a named BD client, a BD office, a BD phone number, BDT pricing or Bangla support.

vendors.name: Provab
weaknesses: Their own Bangladesh page footer lists client geographies — USA, India, Middle East, North America, Far East, Europe, Africa — and omits Bangladesh entirely

vendors.name: Trawex
weaknesses: Bangladesh page carries a 2020 copyright, an empty client-logo strip, and live tiles that read "Dummy Text"
Travel-tech copy bylined to a health writer

vendors.name: Travelopro
vendors.pricing: Publishes a five-tier pricing table in which every price cell is blank
weaknesses: No price, no BD client
vendors.attack: Ask for the number in writing.

vendors.name: Travelomatix
vendors.tag: Useful only as a price anchor
vendors.pricing: Their BD blog tells buyers a white-label portal costs $5,000–10,000 basic, $10,000–25,000 mid, $25,000–60,000+ premium — vendor marketing estimates, not observed transactions
weaknesses: Every tier reads "Enquire Now" on a page copyrighted 2016, citing a 2016 award
Runs a duplicate SEO domain publishing "Top 10 in Bangladesh" listicles about itself
vendors.attack: Quote their anchor honestly, then show a real BD price.

groups.title: The DIY floor
groups.note: Statistically the most common competitor in any deal.

vendors.name: "Amra nijera banabo"
strengths: Feels free
Owner is technically engaged — often your best prospect
weaknesses: GDS certification is a formal months-long process most owners do not know exists
Fare, refund and reissue logic is where in-house builds actually die
Key-person risk when the developer leaves
vendors.attack: Four questions: who handles Sabre/Travelport certification and how long does it take · who writes the refund and reissue logic and what does one wrong rule cost · who maintains it when the developer leaves · our bug fix is 24 hours, what is your freelancer's? Never mock the plan.

gaps: Only two vendors in the entire market publish a price. A written, itemised quote is itself a differentiator.
No foreign vendor has a named Bangladeshi client, a BD office, a BD phone number or Bangla support.
Travonis is a Bangladesh skin on a foreign product — local IP is a real claim if ours is genuinely local.
M360 ships accounting and OTA as two products; one platform that reconciles a booking to a ledger is a straight architectural win.
zooIT sells an explicitly priced HX remover and "no ADM" positioning — sell auditability to anyone with real ADM exposure.
B2B portals give a free storefront but keep the brand, the customer and the data. That is the single sharpest pitch available.
Buy Air Ticket resells shared GDS logins; the credential-sharing ban makes every one of their customers a prospect.
Tour and visa modules are weak or inventory-free across the local field.
Nobody is selling to Cumilla, Brahmanbaria, Khulna or Bogura. First mover takes the district.
